# Protocol 3 native support trial: failed and retained

HP-22. The [receipt](receipt.json) binds clean committed 5aeaa8e, the VCS-attested
binary, pre-dispatch freeze,85 preparations and private native history. The
[report](report.json) and [independent audit](independent-audit.json) agree:

| Frozen denominator | Actual result |
|---|---|
| Planned |85 |
| Actual Messages requests |67, all HTTP200 and settled usage |
| Contract-valid reference matches |66:25 Supported/40 Unsupported/1 Inconclusive |
| Invalid |1, at position67 |
| Not invoked |18 |
| New known usage-priced charge |$0.373832 |
| Prior / cumulative direct stage |$0.778690 / $1.152522 |
| Qualified / document acceptance / UI entry |false |

The [ordinary answer](citation-gap-answer.json) for `oq-c05-case-2` correctly
identifies a citation mismatch: cited f-01 defines a procedure, while uncited f-02
states the asserted event. It returns Unsupported, no positive premise and no
counterfact. Protocol 3 nevertheless requires a nonempty premise/counter source
basis. Capture and report reject the reply; it remains invalid, not a 67th valid
match. This is a response-contract failure, not a measured semantic false support.

The driver stopped immediately and invoked key-free reporting. No retry, fallback,
label/source change, hidden repair or new journal was used. All 85 positions remain
in the denominator. All 67 reservations settled; pending and unknown usage are zero.
Independent local repricing covers input/output/cache buckets and validates native
request/preparation hashes, selected model identity, source/binary and 61 frozen
file hashes. It finds no local ordering, retry or oracle-metadata leakage issue.
Provider billing and transport counts were not independently reconciled.

Raw responses remain private. Three have thinking blocks; the audit examined only
types and usage, never hidden thinking text. The published answer is ordinary
requested rationale. Actual model IDs/configuration stay in private frozen data.
These are public synthetic source cases, with declared rather than authenticated
source/identity evidence; no calibrated accuracy, source truth or effect authority.

[0048](../../../intent/decisions/0048-separate-examined-sources-from-premises.md)
rejects fabricated premises/counters and specifies separate examined-source
provenance under a new protocol. The old four-field codec, report, cost and failed
status remain immutable. [ES](../../../designs/prose-examined-source-review.md)
needs implementation and a distinct full 85 trial before support-site adoption.
The document cohort, session controls, source-status contracts and UI remain open.
